label: Town of Bradford
header:
# Town of Bradford municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 3; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Bradford Selectboard members: Josh Allen (Vice Chair), Meroa Benjamin (Chair), Jean Carlan, Jarrod Kosakowski, and Carole Taylor.

Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): Josh Allen (199), Jarrod Kosakowski (208), and Jean Carlan (182) won the three Selectboard seats filled in 2026.
Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): Nikki Tomlinson (224) won the Town Clerk contest (three-year term).
Town of Bradford official website (bradford-vt.us), Town Clerk page: lists 'Nikki Tomlinson, Town Clerk'.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Nikki Tomlinson as Town Clerk of Bradford (and as interim Treasurer; see the treasurer post's sources).

Town of Bradford official website (bradford-vt.us), 'Treasurer & Assistant Treasurer' page: 'Jessica Chase, Town Treasurer'. The Secretary of State's town treasurer contact spreadsheet (June 12, 2026) still lists Nikki Tomlinson; the town's current page governs.

Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): the Treasurer contest had no ballot candidate; the leading write-in was Nikki Tomlinson (46), who did not take the seat. Chase was seated after the election; the membership is recorded as appointed.

Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): the Moderator contest (one-year term) was won by write-in candidate Paul Hunt (76), the leading write-in; the town identifies Hunt as its current Moderator.
Town of Bradford official website, Listers page: lists Blakelee Danforth (term expires March 2028) and Doug Miller (term expires March 2029), with the third seat vacant.

Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): Doug Miller (216) won the Lister contest filled in 2026. The second 2026 lister contest was led by write-in Marcey Carver (4), whom the town's listers page shows as not seated (the seat is listed vacant), so she is not recorded.

Town of Bradford official website, Auditors page: lists Brianna Haley (term expires March 2028), Alexandra Barlow ('Appointed 2026', term expires March 2029), and Bess Friend (term expires March 2030 as printed). Barlow's membership is recorded as appointed, as the page states.

Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): the 2026 Auditor contests were led by write-ins Elizabeth Friend (20) and Katelynn Pike (40). Friend is the 'Bess Friend' of the town's auditors page; Pike is not on the town's roster and is not recorded.

Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): the Collector of Current Taxes contest (one-year term) was led by write-in Nikki Tomlinson (49). No town page names the holder, and Tomlinson's write-in lead for Treasurer did not seat her in that office, so no holder is recorded from the write-in tally alone.
Town of Bradford official website, 'Treasurer & Assistant Treasurer' page: 'Nikki Tomlinson, Delinquent Tax Collector'.
Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): Tomlinson (44) was also the leading write-in in the Collector of Delinquent Taxes contest.
Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): Gary Moore (215) won the Grand Juror contest (one-year term).
Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): Gary Moore (202) won the Town Agent contest (one-year term).

Town of Bradford, 'Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting' (March 3, 2026, certified): one Trustee of Public Funds seat (three-year term) was filled in 2026, led by write-in Tony Brainerd (44).
Town of Bradford official website, Trustees of Public Funds page: names no trustees. No official source publishes the current holders, so none are recorded.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Bradford justices of the peace: Daniel Perry III, Heather Peets, Nathan Peets, Carole Taylor, Gary Moore, Lawrence Coffin, Patrick Harrigan, Monique Priestley, Leonard Dobbins, and Jonathan Stimson.

Town of Bradford official website, Justices of the Peace page: lists eight of the ten (omitting Harrigan and Dobbins) for the term February 1, 2025 - January 31, 2027; the Secretary of State's listing governs the slate.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Bradford justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
